text: EXHIBIT 18-1 Capital Budgeting Procedures Develop a defined mission, long-range goals, and a business strategy Identify potential capital expenditures Determine whether a proposed expenditure fits mission, goals, and business strategy Perform preliminary data gathering and analysis using financial models Increase analytical rigor and required level of approval as importance and size of project increase Develop implementation plans for approved projects Monitor implementation and revise implementation or project as required Conduct a post audit review to assign responsibilty (to keep initial projections realistic) and improve future planning
